changelog:
training-partner-mgmt v1.0.0

- Initial release for comprehensive management of external training partners.
- Supports registration and classification of institutions (universities, associations, parks, hotels, agents, etc.).
- Enables electronic contract management, including archiving, renewal reminders, and clause tracking.
- Tracks settlement records: payment details, invoices, statements, and outstanding balances.
- Provides partner evaluation: satisfaction scoring, risk level, and health assessment.
- Maintains contact persons and communication history for each partner.
- Structured data model to capture all aspects of partner cooperation lifecycle.
